content.text:
The **next NBA game** is **NBA Finals Game 1: New York Knicks at San Antonio Spurs** on **Wednesday, June 3, 2026, 7:30 PM CT / 8:30 PM ET** at **Frost Bank Center in San Antonio**. ([ticketmaster.com](https://www.ticketmaster.com/search?q=spurs+att&utm_source=openai))

You can get tickets through:

- **Ticketmaster** — the primary/official listing has “Find Tickets” for Game 1 at Frost Bank Center. ([ticketmaster.com](https://www.ticketmaster.com/search?q=spurs+att&utm_source=openai))  
- **Spurs/NBA official ticket pages** — usually route to the same primary marketplace for home games.
- **Verified resale marketplaces** like SeatGeek, TickPick, Gametime, etc.; prices may vary, and finals tickets are reportedly very expensive. ([mysanantonio.com](https://www.mysanantonio.com/sports/spurs/article/knicks-vs-spurs-tickets-nba-finals-22284771.php?utm_source=openai))

Tip: buy only from verified sellers and make sure the ticket can be transferred through Ticketmaster or the official team/NBA app.
